title: Soft aura topological spaces and rough approximation operators
summary: We introduce the concept of a soft aura topological space $(X, \tildeτ, \mathfrak{a}_E)$, obtained by equipping a soft topological space $(X, \tildeτ, E)$ with a soft scope function $\mathfrak{a}_E : X \to \tildeτ$ satisfying $x \in \mathfrak{a}_E(x)(e)$ for every $x \in X$ and every parameter $e \in E$. This framework generalizes the recently introduced aura topological spaces to the soft setting.
